lines.differs: Tougher on AtliQ than CloudSpan: fixed 20% revenue share regardless of service component, whereas CloudSpan followed unspecified referral registration terms.
Tougher on AtliQ than Trustline: revenue is shared 80/20 with Datavane billing customers, versus AtliQ invoicing for fixed milestone fees of $48,000.
Tougher on AtliQ than Rohan: AtliQ gets 20% share of total revenue rather than paying monthly contractor fees for services.
Tougher on AtliQ than CloudSpan: Datavane takes a perpetual license to use anything Partner provides, while CloudSpan only took feedback.
Broadly like Rohan: Datavane takes a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to Partner’s contributions, similar to the license AtliQ took from Rohan.
Tougher on AtliQ than Crestline: AtliQ grants a perpetual license to Datavane, whereas Crestline owned deliverables only upon payment.
Broadly like Crestline: definition and obligations are similar, including disclosure to personnel on a need-to-know basis.
Easier for AtliQ than Orbit: no specified survival period for confidentiality, whereas Orbit required two years post-termination.
Same as Al Noor: identical definition for confidential information and standard requirements for protection and disclosure.
Tougher on AtliQ than PayTrack: unilateral indemnity for any breach or act, whereas PayTrack was mutual and limited to specific gross negligence.
Tougher on AtliQ than Al Noor: includes indemnity for any breach and partner services, while Al Noor was limited to IP infringement.
Tougher on AtliQ than Acme: partner indemnifies for all acts and omissions without the mutual protections signed with Acme.
Tougher on AtliQ than PayTrack: Datavane’s liability is capped at a low $10,000, whereas PayTrack’s cap was the total contract fees.
Tougher on AtliQ than Sunrise: Datavane has a fixed $10,000 cap, while Sunrise allowed a cap equal to fees paid under the SOW.
Tougher on AtliQ than Crestline: Datavane has a tiny $10,000 cap while Partner's liability is unlimited for multiple sections.
Tougher on AtliQ than Crestline: venue is San Francisco under Delaware law, rather than Franklin County, Ohio under Ohio law.
Tougher on AtliQ than Brightwater: shifts jurisdiction from London to San Francisco and governing law from England to Delaware.
Tougher on AtliQ than Al Noor: mandates San Francisco courts and Delaware law instead of Dubai International Financial Centre courts.
